title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS residency + audit logging hardening
author: Samira Ahmed
commits: rbac: introduce policy residency enforcement and audit hooks
kms: add residency-aware key lookup and validation
audit: wire audit events for KMS-residency decisions
tests: add unit+integration for residency enforcement
description: Summary: Enforce KMS key residency constraints at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time and harden audit logging for residency decisions. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require both enforcement of region-bound KMS residency and reliable audit trails that capture why a request was allowed/denied and which key material was selected. This change adds a residency-aware KMS resolver that validates key selection against requested tenant/route residency, extends the RBAC v2 policy enforcer to consult residency predicates, and enriches audit events with residency_key_id, key_region, and enforcement_reason. The PR includes unit and integration tests, helm value toggles for deployment, and docs for operators. Checklist: - Residency-aware KMS resolver implemented and unit-tested - RBAC v2 enforcer consults residency predicates and returns structured deny with reason - Audit events extended and backed by audit-sink schema migration - Helm values default to opt-in for enforcement behind a feature flag - Integration tests covering cross-region key selection and denial paths - Backwards compatible: when enforcement flag is off, behavior is unchanged Breaking change: none when feature flag is off; operators enabling the flag may observe request denials if keys violate residency policies. Migration notes: operators must run the audit-sink schema migration and optionally enable enforcement via helm values-security.yaml. See linked Linear ENG-3551 for rollout plan.
